reported.title: No unlock on door open
reported.description: The sketch never drives D9 LOW when the door opens (D3 HIGH); once locked it stays locked forever, violating the unlock-within-200ms requirement.

reported.title: Debounce edge timer not initialized
reported.description: reqEdge starts at 0, so on the first loop the debounce window is measured from millis()=0 rather than the actual edge; combined with the missing unlock this can cause a spurious immediate engage or missed engage at startup.

truth.description: Lock latches forever after first engage

truth_for_judge.description: Lock latches forever after first engage

exposing_checks.behaviour: D9 must follow its stimulus; LOW when D3 == 1; within 200 ms (Unlocked when door open)

judge_input.spec:
- Request button on D2 (pull-up); door-closed sense on D3 (pull-up, closed = LOW); lock solenoid on D9.
- Lock D9 engages (HIGH) when request D2 is pressed while door D3 is closed (LOW).
- Unlock (D9 LOW) when the door opens (D3 HIGH); unlock within 200 ms of door open.
- Debounce the request contact with 35 ms of stability before engaging.
- Print `vault lock=<0|1> engages=<n>` every 1000 ms.
- Do not re-engage while already locked; wait for a new request after unlock.
